Answer: F
Reason: The pre-operative chest X-ray (Figure 1a) shows a large right-sided mediastinal mass causing significant deviation of the trachea to the left and displacement/compression of the heart. The post-operative image (Figure 1c) demonstrates resolution of the mass with return of the trachea to the midline and normalization of the cardiac silhouette, confirming that both structures were displaced and subsequently realigned.
